shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

en.bdb: Dohra.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦ ਛਕਨੇ ਲਗੋ ਹਾਥ ਸੁਚੇਤ ਕਰਇ॥
verses.translit_en: jo prasaadh chhakane lago haath suchet kari||

en.bdb: Clean your hands (by washing them) before partaking in food.

verses.gurmukhi: ਏਕਾਕੀ ਵਹ ਖਾਇ ਨਹਿ ਅਵਰਨ ਕੋ ਭੀ ਦੇਇ॥੬੧॥
verses.translit_en: ekaakee veh khai neh avaran ko bhee dhei||61||

en.bdb: Do not eat alone by yourself, share it with others.
Many Singhs should gather together and feast;

verses.gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਹੀ ਸੁਠ ਜਗ ਜਸ ਲੀਜੈ॥੬੨॥
verses.translit_en: aaiso hee suTh jag jas leejai||62||

en.bdb: Earn honor through such feasts.
Whenever a Singh goes to relieve himself;
He should purify himself with water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਨ ਜਲ ਮਿਦ ਸੋ ਮਾਰਜਨ ਕਰੇਈ॥
verses.translit_en: pun jal midh so maarajan kareiee||

en.bdb: After washing himself with water;
Only then can he wear the Shastars (weapons).
He should wash himself scrupulously and thoroughly;
Always keep the Kanga (comb) and Karad (knife) tied into your Turban.
When four quarters of the day still remain;
Proceed to perform the five acts of ablutions.
Don the Kanga and knife in your Turban.
This Rehit is befitting for Singhs.
After a fortnight has a passed;
Proceed to wash your hair.
Dry your hair in the sun, keep them clean and pure;

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਇਹ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਮੋਹਰ ਸੁਹਾਵਨ॥੬੯॥
verses.translit_en: hai ieh guroo kee mohar suhaavan||69||

en.bdb: For this is the beautiful seal of the Guru.
Wash your clothes after twenty days at the latest.
When one is hungry, he should freely eat.

verses.gurmukhi: ਯਾ ਸਿਛਾ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਬਰਨੀ॥
verses.translit_en: yaa sichhaa hai gur ke baranee||

en.bdb: This is the teaching which the Guru delivers to you;
Do not do Ardas without a Shastar (weapon).
A Singh who is Rehitvant;
Shall manage his wealthy wisely.
Thus he may provide for the needs of his household.
He never forgets to engage in devotional worship.
One should not eye the Gurdwara for material gains;

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾਂ ਦੋਖ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਨੇ ਬਰਨੀ॥੭੪॥
verses.translit_en: mahaa(n) dhokh hai gur ne baranee||74||

en.bdb: The Guru considers this a great sin.
A Singh who is a priest;

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਭੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਬਹੁਤ ਨ ਗਹੈ॥੭੫॥
verses.translit_en: so bhee poojaa bahut na gahai||75||

en.bdb: he should never take more than necessary from the Gurdwara.
In order to live, he should take what he needs;

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਧਿਕ ਹੋਇ ਤਉ ਜਹਿਂ ਤਹਿਂ ਦੇਵੈ॥੭੬॥
verses.translit_en: adhik hoi tau jahi(n) tahi(n) dhevai||76||

en.bdb: If there is surplus, he should devote it to other causes.
If there is a lot he should devote it to the langar;
He should also direct it towards the maintenance of the Gurdwara.
These offerings should always be used for the welfare of everyone;

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਤ ਯੁਵਤੀ ਹਿਤ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਲੇਈ॥੭੮॥
verses.translit_en: sut yuvatee hit kadhe na leiee||78||

en.bdb: He should not hoard them for his own family.
If one who takes the oblations for himself;
Then the meaning of Dharma will never take root.
Calamities will befall such a person;
Then he will know the pain of his misdeeds.
If a Kurehiti (one who transgresses the Rehit) unapologetically shows face to the world;
By drinking Pahul then earning misdeeds.
Do not mingle with such people;
Staying away from them, you will attain supreme peace.
